techniques.name: ShapPFN
techniques.capability_enabled: Tabular foundation model that integrates Shapley value regression into its architecture, producing predictions and feature-importance explanations in a single forward pass, ~1000x faster than KernelSHAP (0.06s vs 610s).
techniques.code_evidence: WebSearch result block states code is available at GitHub: https://github.com/kunumi/ShapPFN
techniques.verbatim_quote: ShapPFN is a foundation model that integrates Shapley value regression directly into its architecture, producing both predictions and explanations in a single forward pass.

techniques.name: CANDI (Curated Test-Time Adaptation)
techniques.capability_enabled: Test-time adaptation framework for multivariate time-series anomaly detection under distribution shift; uses False Positive Mining and a plug-and-play Spatiotemporally-Aware Normality Adaptation module, improving AUROC up to 14% with fewer adaptation samples.
techniques.code_evidence: WebSearch result block: 'The code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/kimanki/CANDI'
techniques.verbatim_quote: CANDI introduces a False Positive Mining (FPM) strategy to curate adaptation samples based on anomaly scores and latent similarity, and incorporates a plug-and-play Spatiotemporally-Aware Normality Adaptation (SANA) module for structurally informed model updates.

techniques.name: ViT3 / ViTTT (Vision Test-Time Training)
techniques.capability_enabled: Pure test-time-training architecture for vision achieving linear complexity and parallelizable computation; matches/outperforms Mamba and linear-attention variants across image classification, generation, object detection, and semantic segmentation. CVPR 2026 Oral.
techniques.code_evidence: Official GitHub repo surfaced in multiple result blocks: https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/ViTTT ('[CVPR 2026] [Oral] Official repository of Vision Test-Time Training'); search states 'code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/ViTTT'.
techniques.verbatim_quote: The Vision Test-Time Training (ViT3) model is a pure TTT architecture that achieves linear complexity and parallelizable computation.

techniques.name: VISION (Graph Few-Shot Learning via In-Context Learning)
techniques.capability_enabled: Reframes graph few-shot node classification as a fine-tuning-free sequence reasoning (in-context learning) problem; conditions on the support set and generates class-aware query representations in a single forward pass, unifying unsupervised meta-learning with graph in-context learning.
techniques.code_evidence: Search summary states 'The public code is available, making it an open-source method'; abstract fragment quotes 'Our public code can be found' but the explicit GitHub URL was not surfaced in result blocks. Code availability asserted by authors; direct repo link not yet seen.
techniques.verbatim_quote: The method unifies unsupervised meta-learning with graph in-context learning, achieving efficient inference.

techniques.name: KernelICL
techniques.capability_enabled: Makes tabular-foundation-model in-context learning interpretable by replacing the final prediction layer with explicit kernel functions (Gaussian, dot-product, kNN), so each prediction is a transparent weighted average of training labels; matches existing TFMs on 55 TALENT datasets.
techniques.code_evidence: No GitHub link or explicit code-release statement surfaced in WebSearch result blocks; targeted search for KernelICL code returned no repository.
techniques.verbatim_quote: The key innovation is building on the insight that in-context learning is akin to kernel regression, making this mechanism explicit by replacing the final prediction layer with kernel functions (Gaussian, dot-product, kNN) so that every prediction is a transparent weighted average of training labels.

techniques.name: TabFORGE (Tabular Foundation Model for Generative Modelling)
techniques.capability_enabled: Tabular foundation model for synthetic-data generation built on pretrained causality-aware latent representations; two-stage design (score-based diffusion transformer + denoising-aligned decoder) to mitigate train/inference latent distribution shift; evaluated vs 22 baselines on 45 datasets.
techniques.code_evidence: No official GitHub repository or code-release statement surfaced; targeted searches returned only the arXiv page (no repo). Recently posted (~May 2026).
techniques.verbatim_quote: TabFORGE is designed to utilise the implicitly learned causal information underlying diverse tabular datasets in a unified latent space induced by a pretrained causality-aware feature encoder.
